tldr: A shared population subsidy quota couples treatment decisions across groups even when within-group benefit rankings are known. On the entire bounded nondecreasing two-group drift class, exact complete-PAVA projected-likelihood convergence yields original full-response and calibrated-release experiment limits and their exact local minimax treatment-regret constants. The calibrated constant is strictly larger: \(0<V_{\mathrm{full}}<V_{\mathrm{cal}}\le1/2\), and \(M_n^{\mathrm{cal}}-M_n^{\mathrm{full}}\to V_{\mathrm{cal}}-V_{\mathrm{full}}>0\). Total original-data selectors attain both constants while spending exactly population mass \(1/2\) on every input. A terminating finite rational procedure brackets both values to any positive rational tolerance and returns a certified positive rational lower bound on their difference. Constants, jumps, plateaus, and ties remain in the same class throughout. The result concerns the declared triangular Bernoulli benchmark.
